summary: Reladraw is a web‑frontend diagram language and editor that lets users place elements explicitly, offering fine‑grained layout control. It runs as a CLI that renders SVGs and as a web app, built with TypeScript and distributed via npm. It suits developers who need precise diagram positioning beyond what Mermaid or PlantUML provide. Its standout strength is very fast rendering (≈4 ms and 20× faster than Mermaid), while the main caveat is that none of the three functional tests passed, indicating reliability issues.
